verifyEmailTemplate.subject: Verify your GradeGlow email
verifyEmailTemplate.body:
Hello %DISPLAY_NAME%,

Welcome to GradeGlow - your virtual university for workplace labs, textbooks, and AI professors.

Verify your email address:
%LINK%

If you did not create a GradeGlow account, you can ignore this message.

- GradeGlow Team

resetPasswordTemplate.subject: Reset your GradeGlow password
resetPasswordTemplate.body:
Hello,

We received a request to reset the password for your GradeGlow account (%EMAIL%).

Choose a new password here:
%LINK%

If you did not request this, you can safely ignore this email.

- GradeGlow Team

changeEmailTemplate.subject: Confirm your new GradeGlow email
changeEmailTemplate.body:
Hello,

Confirm your new email address for GradeGlow (%NEW_EMAIL%):
%LINK%

If you did not request this change, contact us immediately.

- GradeGlow Team

revertSecondFactorAdditionTemplate.subject: GradeGlow security notice
revertSecondFactorAdditionTemplate.body:
Hello,

Someone tried to add multi-factor authentication to your GradeGlow account.

If this was not you, use this link to remove the change:
%LINK%

- GradeGlow Team
